name: Shah Mohammad
bio: Shah Mohammad (about 1780-1862) was a Punjabi poet of Batala in the Gurdaspur district, who lived through the last years of the Sikh kingdom of Ranjit Singh and its fall to the British East India Company.

He is remembered above all for the Jangnama (also called Jang Singhan te Farangian), a verse chronicle of the first Anglo-Sikh war of 1845-46. He also wrote a Punjabi retelling of the Persian Shahnama story of Rustam.
